draft.shortGloss: to go (by vehicle); to travel; to drive
draft.emotion: a sense of movement and direction, purposeful and focused on the journey
notes: Use 'fahren' for any transport involving a vehicle (car, bus, train, bike), unlike 'gehen', which means to go on foot.
Strong verb with a stem vowel change: 'du fährst', 'er/sie/es fährt'; past tense 'fuhr'; past participle 'gefahren'.
Takes 'sein' in the perfect tense for movement from place to place ('Ich bin nach Berlin gefahren'), and 'haben' when driving an object ('Ich habe das Auto gefahren').
